item.title: Murder FIR on 10-yr-old girl for pushing toddler from sixth floor in Mumbai
item.description: An 18-month-old toddler fell to her death from a sixth-floor stairwell in Goregaon. Police registered a murder FIR against her 10-year-old neighbor based on the mother's complaint. The child's mother stated that the older girl had gestured for her daughter to approach her. After the incident, the 10-year-old was placed in counseling through an NGO. Experts emphasize the importance of rehabilitation for the young girl rather than punitive measures.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Avengers Assemble: From Captain America to Spider-Man, superheroes run wild in France
item.description: Recent protests in France saw participants dressed as superheroes like Captain America, Batman, and Spider-Man. While demonstrations began with student grievances, they broadened to include various groups united against rising living costs. In cities like Marseille and Paris, clashes with police erupted, where costumed figures captured attention amid the unrest. Additionally, historical figures such as Napoleon were also spotted among demonstrators.
item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: Harmanpreet Kaur breaks down on live TV, reveals what has changed
item.description: Harmanpreet Kaur achieved a remarkable performance by scoring 91 runs against Zimbabwe in a recent T20I. Her innings marked a significant comeback after struggling for form in previous matches. She expressed gratitude towards those who supported her during challenging times in her career. After stepping down as captain, she found relief and confidence to enjoy her game once more.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: Mother, lover, son kill 13-year-old twins who opposed their relationship
item.description: In Badesra village, two twin brothers, Vinay and Vishnu Chaudhary, were found murdered on Tuesday morning. Their mother, Preeti, allegedly conspired with her paramour to kill them due to their opposition to her relationship. The police discovered the bodies showing multiple injuries, including slit throats and head wounds. Preeti's 16-year-old son also participated in the crime, supporting his mother.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann 'detained for 3 hours' at Delhi airport, fined Rs 50k
item.description: Aam Aadmi Party has alleged that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was detained at Delhi airport recently. He was held for three hours and subsequently issued a challan of Rs 50,000. AAP officials claim this incident reflects a deliberate attempt to humiliate Mann by the BJP-led central government. The party asserts that this move undermines the dignity of Punjab.
item.dc:creator: VIBHOR MOHAN

item.title: Qualcomm layoffs: CEO says job cuts target areas falling short of expectations
item.description: Qualcomm plans to implement global layoffs in response to performance evaluations and organizational needs. CEO Cristiano Amon has stated that job cuts will start in November this year. The company aims to create a stronger performance culture to meet business priorities. Despite recent challenges, Qualcomm expects to achieve growth in non-handset sectors by fiscal 2027.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Indian-origin teen Dev Rai's nonprofit helps 400+ artisans, sells 900 products
item.description: At just 15 years old, Dev Rai launched Serving Society Global Foundation, aiming to uplift India's traditional artisans. This growing nonprofit has generated over $15,000 and engaged more than 300 volunteers. By creating essential connections between artisans and American consumers through community initiatives, Rai envisions a future where these artisans can thrive through digital platforms, enhancing cultural heritage while empowering youth in entrepreneurship and leadership roles.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Jio IPO opens for subscription: Price band, GMP to brokerage views
item.description: Jio Platforms IPO: The company has fixed the price band at Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 per share. Based on the offer documents, the IPO values the company at around $108 billion. Investors will be able to apply for Jio Platforms shares in lots of 12, or in multiples of 12 shares.
item.dc:creator: SMRITI JAIN

item.title: Day after 3 Meiteis killed, Kuki man shot dead as Manipur violence escalates
item.description: Paolenmung Thangeo, a 45-year-old Kuki tribesman, was killed by gunmen while collecting bamboo shoots. This incident took place in Kangpokpi, Manipur, amidst rising tensions. His companion managed to escape unharmed during the attack. Just a day earlier, three Meitei villagers were ambushed and killed in the same area. Authorities have begun investigations, resulting in the arrest of three suspects connected to the earlier incident.
item.dc:creator: PRABIN KALITA

item.title: UP village women turn water hyacinth into fashion for Lakmé Fashion Week
item.description: In Uttar Pradesh, women are being empowered to transform dried water hyacinth into beautiful handcrafted products. This initiative not only cultivates valuable skills but also enables them to generate income while remaining in their communities. Under the guidance of designer Anurag Gupta, these talented artisans showcased their sustainable fashion creations at Lakmé Fashion Week, highlighting their remarkable craftsmanship.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Keith Haring mural once hidden behind drywall now in New York's $25m loft
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan marks 10 years in Hawaii, donates $1.48m to hospital
item.description: In a remarkable gesture of generosity, Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have contributed $1.48 million to the Wilcox Medical Center in Kauaʻi. This donation will be utilized to purchase a mobile MRI unit and a 3D mammography machine, reinforcing their decade-long commitment to enhancing healthcare in the community. Overall, their philanthropy has exceeded $4 million, fundamentally improving access to vital medical resources for local residents.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
item.description: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: 'Quiet, quiet, are you a sick person?' Trumps snaps at reporter at White House; watch
item.dc:creator: AASTHA JHA

item.title: Asian Para Games: Sachin wins gold as India sweep all three shot put medals
item.description: India won all three medals in the men’s shot put F46 event at the Asian Para Games on Wednesday, with Sachin Sarjerao Khilari taking gold with a Games record. Khilari, a silver medallist at the Paris Paralympics, defended the gold he had won at the previous edition of the Games in China. He produced his best throw of 15.87m with his sixth and final attempt to set a new Games record.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: 'My journey began with Ramleela': Ravi Kishan portrays Ram during Dussehra celebrations
item.dc:creator: AASTHA JHA

item.title: CJP's Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka move Delhi HC; cases handed to Crime Branch
item.description: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have approached the Delhi High Court to challenge their judicial custody. They were detained after climbing a gate to protest at Jantar Mantar on October 13. The initial five-day custody was followed by a two-day extension, which expires on Wednesday. Their case has been transferred to the Crime Branch for further investigation and handling.
item.dc:creator: ABHINAV GARG

item.title: ‘Who will talk to me, and why?’: Shami’s blunt take after selectors overlook him
item.description: Mohammed Shami is determined to fight for his place in the Indian cricket team. He insists that he remains in peak fitness and continues to focus on domestic cricket. Shami completed the previous domestic season and aims to stay prepared for future series and tournaments. While he welcomed Bhuvneshwar Kumar's return, he voiced concerns about communications with selectors. Shami emphasizes the importance of loyalty and dedication to his team, Bengal.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: Family cruise trip cancelled without notice; commission orders Rs 54K payout
item.description: A family's dream cruise was abruptly canceled without warning, leaving them in distress. The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in Kerala found both the holiday company and cruise operator at fault. Despite repeated attempts to secure a refund after the cancellation, the complainant was denied compensation. The commission mandated a refund along with additional compensation for the trouble caused, allowing one month for compliance before penalties escalate.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: Trump wants ‘New America’ for New Mexico, reviving debate on America’s name
item.description: Donald Trump proposed renaming New Mexico to New America, claiming it would enhance pride among residents and change election integrity. Political representatives from New Mexico opposed the idea, emphasizing the state's historical significance and established name. Constitutional barriers exist, as name changes require formal processes involving local and national laws. Historical context surrounding America’s naming is complex and reflects a mix of cultural influences.
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: Inside Vijay Sethupathi's grand Chennai house worth Rs 50 crore
item.description: Vijay Sethupathi, an accomplished actor in Tamil cinema, has a significant residence in Chennai valued around Rs 50 crore. He has recently released his film 'Baththa', which has received positive feedback from audiences. Born on January 16, 1978, he worked various jobs before pursuing acting full-time after returning from Dubai. The actor has maintained a low profile regarding his property investments, which are spread across Chennai.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: CBI registers FIR in murder of anti-drug activist Jhota, team reaches Punjab
item.description: The Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case regarding the murder of Parvinder Singh Jhota. Jhota was shot dead inside a medical store in Punjab's Mansa while hosting a Facebook Live session. Following demands from his family, Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann announced the case's transfer to the CBI. Union Home Minister Amit Shah welcomed this decision but criticized the state government for not addressing other drug-related cases.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: India-US ‘pretty close’ to signing a ‘different kind of deal,’ says Trump
item.description: After prolonged negotiations, India and the United States are on the verge of solidifying a crucial trade agreement. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio noted the strategic alignment between the two countries during his visit to India. With a shared sense of optimism, both parties are excited about the latest developments in the Bilateral Trade Agreement discussions.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Tiger Shroff shooting case: Police lens on Lawrence's US-based aide Randeep Malik
item.description: Anil Pandit Pandit and Shroff ’s shooter Rehan both reported to Malik and were considered “his men” till a few months ago, a source said. Rehan had been earlier tasked by Malik and Pandit with a shooting incident in Sonipat as well. “Rehan was shown the same ‘American dream’ that Malik had shown Pandit in the past,” a source said.
item.dc:creator: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA

item.title: Captive-bred GIB released into wild killed by fox
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 2 British Indians assaulted during Dussehra, Bathukamma celebrations
item.description: The assaults happened on Oct 17 outside Ossett Town Hall, which was hosting the celebration. The event was organised by local Telugu Hindu community groups. Earlier in the evening a group of around 25 local white youths, mostly male, were cycling around on e-bikes asking organisers what was going on in the town hall and who was inside.
item.dc:creator: NAOMI CANTON

item.title: Musk ordered Starlink slowdown, kept Ukraine and Trump administration in dark
item.description: US officials, however, have denied ordering any slowdown. Defence secretary Pete Hegseth said Washington had not directed any reduction in the satellite services, while secretary of state Marco Rubio maintained that the White House was not responsible for the reported disruption. Speaking to reporters, Hegseth said the US military had not instructed any changes to the satellite service used by Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Identify, defeat forces against India: Modi calls for unity, self-reliance
item.description: PM urges parties, institutions to put nation first; says national self-respect and strength key to overcoming challenges
item.dc:creator: MANASH PRATIM GOHAIN

item.title: ‘Play as late as possible’: Gavaskar’s advice to India batters for NZ Tests
item.description: Sunil Gavaskar has provided guidance for Indian batters ahead of the Test series against New Zealand. He emphasized the importance of patience and technique to withstand swing and seam conditions. Gavaskar also mentioned that adjusting to the time difference will benefit the Indian team during the series. He expressed concern about the limited two-Test format and its potential to yield inconclusive results.
item.dc:creator: GAURAV GUPTA

item.title: Oil prices today: Brent crude tops $110 as Middle East tensions threaten shipments
item.description: Oil prices have risen due to growing concerns over disruptions in Middle East supplies and threats to shipping routes. Recent attacks on vessels and infrastructure have heightened worries among traders and analysts. While Brent crude futures climbed to $110.10, WTI crude also saw an increase following previous declines. US officials are working with refiners to address rising fuel prices and shortages.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Dale Steyn’s 18-year-old record falls as Harmer scripts history against Australia
item.description: Simon Harmer made headlines with an impressive 82 in the second Test against Australia, eclipsing the previous record of 76 runs held by Dale Steyn for South African No. 9 batsmen. His performance was vital in rescuing South Africa from a challenging position of 110-6. Partnering with Temba Bavuma, their formidable eighth-wicket alliance totaled 183 runs. South Africa eventually declared at 425-9, while Australia wrapped up Day 3 at 3-1.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: In talks with Reliance to refine more Venezuelan oil: Marco Rubio
item.description: US secretary of state Marco Rubio is visiting Jamnagar Wednesday to tour the Reliance refinery and, in a lastminute change of schedule, is likely to spend the night there. He was earlier scheduled to leave around 9pm and return to Mumbai. In Jamnagar, he will have dinner with Mukesh Ambani at the Vantara centre. Rubio’s visit to Jamnagar comes within weeks of a vicious attack on Ambani by Elon Musk.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 'Russia a big machine': Trump says Ukraine 'has to want' to settle war with Putin
item.description: US president Trump pointed to Russia's ability to sustain its military campaign and capture territory, portraying Moscow as having the upper hand in the conflict. "Russia is a big machine - they just keep grinding forward, and that's what they've done. They've taken a very large piece of land," he said.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: 'Darlings' actor Divya Vinekar passes away
item.description: Divya Vinekar's sudden departure was revealed by RJ Rohini Ramnathan via social media, marking an emotional moment for many. Requesting privacy for the grieving family, Ramnathan provided details for the cremation for those eager to honor Vinekar's memory. She graced screens with memorable performances in 'Darlings' and 'Jalsa', known for her professionalism and kindness, and her legacy continues to resonate within the film community.
item.dc:creator: etimes.in

item.title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a 'good idea', special committees formed for talks
item.description: SpaceX shares rose 4.9% in extended trading following the remarks. Speculation about a potential deal has grown in recent weeks, with Barclays suggesting last week that an announcement could come before Tesla's annual meeting in December. Musk has previously floated the idea, pointing to increasing overlap between the businesses. The merger discussions came as SpaceX reported its first profit as a public company.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Hacker group claims access to 3.8 lakh SBI data entries
item.description: The claim was highlighted by cybersecurity monitoring account CyberPulse56 in a post on social media platform X. According to the account, the group purportedly possesses about 3.8 lakh data entries in CSV format and 2,722 pdf documents associated with the country’s largest public sector lender. The allegedly exposed dataset is said to contain customers’ personal information, residential addresses, loan applications, supporting documents and other applicationrelated records.
item.dc:creator: Agencies

item.title: Former NBA All-Star Amar'e Stoudemire joins police academy in Florida
item.description: Amar’e Stoudemire has officially completed his training at the Basic Law Enforcement Academy and is ready to embark on a new chapter with the Miami-Dade Schools Police Department. Inspired by his family's legacy in law enforcement, Stoudemire, who retired from the NBA in 2016, also explored international basketball while establishing his own wine brand.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: NBA commissioner Adam Silver responds to LeBron James' Fanatics helicopter deal
item.description: LeBron James has adopted a helicopter for his daily commute to the Philadelphia 76ers from New York City, a move confirmed by NBA commissioner Adam Silver as compliant with league regulations. This travel arrangement is a result of James' collaboration with Fanatics, structured to adhere to NBA rules, ensuring no impact on salary cap terms. Speculation around this perk links to the ties between James and the owner of Fanatics.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Allahabad HC cites long trial, lets off offenders, SC slams ‘misplaced sympathy’
item.description: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran said it was a case of misplaced sympathy. The trial court had awarded fiveyear jail terms to the two, but the HC released them on probation. SC said the case was “doomed from its inception insofar as justice delivery to the victim is concerned”.
item.dc:creator: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY

item.title: Desi Bela Bajaria leaves Netflix after giving global blockbusters
item.description: Bela Bajaria has stepped down from her role as chief content officer at Netflix amid significant challenges in the media landscape. She oversaw an impressive annual budget of almost $20 billion while bolstering Netflix's international content strategy. With a decline in audience engagement highlighting the industry's evolution, the streaming giant is poised for a transformative approach. Peter Rice, formerly of Disney and Fox, is set to take the helm.
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: Delhi HC cites national security, junks CIC order to IAF on PMs’ foreign trips
item.description: Allowing a petition by the Central Public Information Officer of Directorate of Personal Services, Air Headquarters, Justice Amit Mahajan held the IAF was justified in denying access to the records under section 8 of RTI that exempts disclosure of information that could jeopardise national security or pose a risk to a person’s life and physical safety.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Smartphone shipments slip, Chinese brands lose ground
item.description: Vivo’s shipments dropped 34% to 6.4 million — the sharpest decline among the top five. Repeated price increases disrupted retailers’ inventory planning, while limited supplies of entry-level phones weakened its position. Xiaomi’s traditional appeal of offering more features for the money also came under pressure. Rising component costs forced trade-offs on pricing and memory configurations, with shipments falling 28% to 4.7 million.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman warns of unrest bid by ‘2 united parties’
item.description: PM said attempts were made to create labour unrest at some factories in different parts of the country, adding that intelligence reports indicated that the ousted authoritarian regime was supplying money for such activities. “There is a party also here that spreads rumours in the country. The party tried to sell various tickets to the people before the election by telling lies. These two parties have now united,” he said.
item.dc:creator: AHSAN TASNIM

item.title: India, US ‘perfectly aligned’ on key issues: Rubio; defends ties with Pakistan
item.description: Addressing a gathering of India Inc’s leading business figures, Rubio said the relationship between the two countries could help shape the future of the global economy, particularly as advances in artificial intelligence and quantum computing transform industries and societies. “I truly believe the relationship between US and India is defining, in many ways, in a positive way, what the 21st century can look like,” he said.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: India & US to boost defence, energy ties, Marco Rubio says trade deal close
item.description: Rubio’s second visit to India comes against the backdrop of the US’s Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which is intended to penalise countries purchasing Russian oil, and Trump’s subsequent temporary suspension of related tariffs. India maintains that its oil procurement is essential not only for its own energy security but also for the stability of global markets. Rubio lauded the “substantial progress” made by India in diversifying its energy portfolio.
item.dc:creator: SACHIN PARASHAR
